title: Dynamic reconfiguration of hydrogen-bonded networks to modulate perovskite crystallization
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07159C, Paper
Jiaxue Zhai, Huān Bì, Shiji Zhang, Lin Xie, Bin Wu, Peng Wang, Shifeng Ge, Shafidah Shafian, Jiayan Chen, Wenhua Zhang, Yong Zhang, Nam-Gyu Park, Yong Hua
Sterically tuned DESs reconfigure dynamic H-bond networks to control perovskite crystallization. Replacing the H-bond donor urea with N-methylurea strengthens localized coordination, stabilizes precursors, and yields uniform, low-defect films.
